name: Tabs
description:
In-page tabs on Base UI's tabs: `Root` (selected value, controlled or uncontrolled),
`List` (the tab strip from `items`; tabs that do not fit move to a More menu) and
`Panel`. For tabs that are routes, use `TabNav`.

slots.name: Root
slots.signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, className, children, ...rest }: TabsRootProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next tab. Write it to the URL when the tab is a place (R6.2).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.type: React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, import("@base-ui/react").TabsRootState> | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the tab list for assistive tech, e.g. "NST-C106 sections".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: dragType
props.description:
What a dragged tab carries. Strips with the same type under one DragDropProvider exchange
tabs, and a DropZone with this `accept` anywhere under it takes them as an ordinary drop:
`event.item.id` is the value and `event.item.data` is {@link TabDragData}. Each value must
be unique under the provider. A strip with no provider above brings its own.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
A closable tab asks to close: from its close mark, a middle-click, Delete, its context
menu or the strip's Close button. Remove it from `items` to close it, or keep it (ask
first when it is `unsaved`, R13.7). When the active tab goes, its neighbour is selected,
and focus that was on it moves to the tab now in its place.

props.name: onKeep
props.description: A `preview` tab should stay: double-clicked, or Keep open in its menu. Clear `preview` in response.

props.name: onTabMove
props.description:
Makes tabs reorderable: by drag on a pointer that hovers, Shift with the arrow keys (in
reading direction), Shift+Home and Shift+End, and Move rows in the context menu, the
single-pointer route (WCAG 2.5.7). The strip owns no list: each move reports here, once,
on the strip it lands on, and `items` changes when you change it. A keyboard move selects
the tab, so it stays visible (R6.6). Dragging is off where nothing hovers (touch).

props.name: panelId
props.description:
The id of a tab's panel when panels render outside `Tabs.Panel`: sets the tab's
`aria-controls`. Return undefined for a panel that is not in the document, since the
attribute must name an element that exists.

props.name: ref
props.description: The strip's handle: {@link TabListHandle}.

props.name: zoneId
props.description: This strip's id in the drag system, and `from` and `to` in {@link TabMove}. Default generated.

slots.name: Panel
slots.signature: ({ className, ...rest }: ComponentProps<typeof BaseTabs.Panel> & { className?: string; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.type: string | (((state: import("@base-ui/react").TabsPanelState) => string | undefined) & string) | undefined
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the HTML element in the DOM while the panel is hidden.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.type: React.ReactElement<unknown, string | React.JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, import("@base-ui/react").TabsPanelState> | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description: The value of the TabPanel. It will be shown when the Tab with the corresponding value is active.
